title: Ivan the Great Bell Tower
summary: The Ivan the Great Bell Tower stands in the Moscow Kremlin, Russia. UNESCO says it was built in 1505-1508 and was 82 metres high, the highest building in Russia. Course notes from Northern Virginia Community College say an addition was made in 1600 under Boris Godunov.

uncertainty.note: Start is 1505 and the first tower was finished in 1508; the 1600 date is the addition ordered under Boris Godunov.

as_recorded.value: In 1505-1508 the bell tower of Ivan Veliki was built.

where.modern_name: Ivan the Great Bell Tower, Moscow Kremlin, Moscow, Russia
where.historical_name: Bell tower of Ivan Veliki, Moscow Kremlin, Grand Duchy of Moscow

importance.justification: UNESCO names it among the most significant Kremlin churches and calls it the focal point of the ensemble.
